# NJ Fence and Railing

> Providing top-tier fencing and railing solutions for the most demanding residential and commercial projects across New Jersey.

## About
NJ Fence and Railing is a premier contractor based in Passaic, New Jersey. We specialize in custom railing, aluminum fences, and professional repair services. Our mission is to deliver high-quality, durable, and aesthetically pleasing solutions for both residential and commercial properties.

## Contact & Location
- Address: 2 Brighton Ave Fl 3, Passaic, NJ 07055, USA
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/LQWq6qD66SBFUw2c6
- Website: https://njnyfenceandrailing.com

## Main Services
- Custom Railing: Tailor-made railing solutions designed to match your property's style and safety requirements.
- Aluminum Fence: Durable, weather-resistant aluminum fencing installations for security and curb appeal.
- Repair Services: Expert maintenance, restoration, and repair of existing fences and railings.
